7192.title: Lifecycle hooks lose authenticated CLI routing
7192.rootCauseOneLine: Lifecycle sanitization removes the machine-auth proxy endpoint, so CLI configuration falls back to loopback; direct routing does not supply machine headers.
7192.proposedFix: Define and document a machine-scoped CLI endpoint contract for lifecycle subprocesses, preserving thread isolation and avoiding raw credential inheritance.
7192.caveats: Two clean Linux runs verified the portable mechanism and real CLI/proxy controls; native Windows, hosted Connect moves, HTTP 410, and terminal creation were not exercised. Full test and output are inline per reports repository policy. No automatic fix because authentication-context changes fail simple-fix eligibility.
